name: Jazz in the Space Age de George Russell – Mário Laginha & Miguel Meirinhos + Orquestra Jazz de Matosinhos
description: The Orquestra Jazz de Matosinhos performs George Russell's masterpiece "Jazz in the Space Age," featuring Mário Laginha and Miguel Meirinhos as solo pianists. This event celebrates Russell's legacy and his revolutionary approach to jazz theory.
longDescription:
The Orquestra Jazz de Matosinhos will perform George Russell's "Jazz in the Space Age," a work that exemplifies his groundbreaking musical theories. Russell's concepts were pivotal in shaping jazz, influencing figures like Miles Davis and John Coltrane, and contributing to the development of modal jazz. This performance features two pianists, Mário Laginha and Miguel Meirinhos, as soloists. 

The concert takes place at Casa da Música on November 22, 2026, starting at 9:30 PM in Sala Suggia. Tickets are priced between €26.00 and €30.00, with various discounts available for young people, seniors, students, and other groups. Pedro Guedes will direct the musical performance.
